description: Robin returns from the Crusades to find Nottingham under brutal rule, gathers a band of outlaws in Sherwood and begins a campaign against the Sheriff while his bond with Marian is tested by Gisborne.

s01e01.description: Robin returns from the Crusades to find Locksley crushed by the Sheriff's rule, forcing him to choose between reclaiming his estate and openly resisting Nottingham.

s01e02.description: The Sheriff retaliates against Locksley after Robin's defiance, pushing Robin toward the outlaw life that will define his fight.

s01e03.description: A sniper murders people in Nottingham and frames Robin, forcing him into a temporary alliance with the Sheriff to expose the real killer.

s01e04.description: The outlaws find an abandoned baby in Sherwood just as Roy is captured, turning a rescue mission into an unexpectedly domestic crisis.

s01e05.description: The Nottingham Fair and its silver-arrow contest give Robin a chance to strike at the Sheriff while confronting the exploitation hidden behind the spectacle.

s01e06.description: Robin uses a captured tax inspector as his route into Nottingham Castle, only to discover that the Sheriff's financial machinery is more dangerous than expected.

s01e07.description: Allan's reunion with his brother Tom brings a band of reckless thieves into the gang's orbit and tests where family loyalty ends.

s01e08.description: A raid on Gisborne's birthday celebration exposes a disturbing secret connected to King Richard and forces Robin to reconsider what Guy truly serves.

s01e09.description: An inventor's black powder becomes a lethal prize, leaving Robin to protect both its creator and a discovery that could transform warfare.

s01e10.description: A Saracen visitor at Nottingham Castle draws Robin into a web of diplomacy, suspicion and the Sheriff's attempt to turn cultural fear into advantage.

s01e11.description: Little John's son is arrested during a brutal tax collection, making the outlaws' fight against the Sheriff painfully personal.

s01e12.description: News that King Richard has returned throws Nottingham into upheaval while Marian faces an imminent marriage to Gisborne.

s01e13.description: Robin struggles with the apparent loss of Marian as Edward's attempt to confront the returning king uncovers a far more dangerous deception.
